The '''varasquactyl''' was a [[Mutant|mutated]] creature, the result of mixing the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] between [[Squill (creature)|squills]] and [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyls]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The varasquactyl was a creature in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
